newsitem.title: USA: Recount ordered in Massachusetts' 6th Congress race.
newsitem.headline: Recount ordered in Massachusetts' 6th Congress race.

text.p: Massachusetts officials Wednesday ordered a recount for the state's sixth congressional district.
Democrat John Tierney leads Republican incumbent Peter Torkildsen by 360 votes, or less than one half of 1.0 percent according to the Secretary of the Commonwealth William Galvin.
Torkildsen filed petitions for a recount after the initial results were certified by the Governor's Council Wednesday.
The recount is scheduled to begin Thursday and be completed by Monday, Dec. 2, Galvin said in a statement.
If Tierney prevails it will mean the entire congressional delegation from Massachusetts will be Democratic.
